rationale: AOSS provisioning

rationale: Explicit OSIS + S3 + AOSS ingestion intent

rationale: RCA phrased as a chain that must close, with unruled-out alternatives visible

rationale: Pure log query -- guards the unclosed boundary from capturing log-analytics traffic
